headline: Parvesh Verma to Kapil Mishra: 6 prominent faces expected in Delhi's Cabinet
content:
Parvesh Verma, the son of former Delhi CM Sahib Singh Verma, won the New Delhi seat against AAP chief and ex-Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal with a margin of 4,089 votes.

Kapil Mishra defeated AAP's Manoj Kumar Tyagi by a margin of 23,355 votes in the Karawal Nagar seat.

Manjinder Singh Sirsa secured victory in the Rajouri Garden assembly seat with a margin of 18,190 votes.

Ravinder Indraj Singh won from Bawana by a margin of 31,475 votes.

One of Delhi BJP’s key Punjabi figures, Ashish Sood, secured victory in Janakpuri by 18,766 votes.

Pankaj Singh won from the Vikaspuri assembly seat by a margin of 12,876 votes.
